artist_statement.text:
No Access


A small house rests alone beneath an open night sky, surrounded not by walls, but by quiet signals of restriction. A narrow path leads toward the structure, interrupted by a simple gate and a warning that transforms the landscape from peaceful to controlled.


The work explores how boundaries are created not always through force or scale, but through suggestion, distance, and the feeling that something beyond the threshold is intentionally protected. What appears calm from afar slowly becomes uneasy the longer it is observed.


Created using handmade miniatures and focus stacking to build depth and scale while preserving the tactile quality of a constructed world.


Camera: Nikon D750


Lens: Tamron 17–35mm


Focal Length: 24mm


Exposure: 30 seconds


Aperture: f/3.2


ISO: 6400


Processed in Adobe Photoshop


I, Veerendra Jillella, declare that if this piece is selected and purchased by the 6529 Network Museum, this work will be released under CC0 and I have full rights to make that release.
